message:
fix(multicursor): edit applied twice at cursor overlapping the primary #42050

Problem:
A cursor overlapping the primary is deduped by comparing positions at
the clock edge, i.e. after the primary edit executed. A "replace" at the
cursor cell ("rx", "~", "g~iw") shifts the overlapping extmark, so it no
longer matches and gets its own replay. E.g. "vipQg~~" applies twice to
the 2nd line, which inverts the effect.

Solution:
Decide "overlaps the primary" at cmd start, before the edit.
